notes: Read the full 162-line numbered source before editing. Module JSDoc (L1-12) describing the thin TreeSelect wrapper, the category grouping, the friendly labels, and the lazy SignalSparklinePreview leaf slot is condensed into the native header comment. Imports (L14-18): useMemo (L14) is kept; TreeSelect + the TreeGroup type from @/components/forms (L15) and the ./SignalSparklinePreview sibling (L18) have no native port yet, so both are reproduced in-file as native-safe implementations (see notes below) and a local TreeGroup/TreeLeaf type pair mirrors the web shapes; useAvailableSignals (L16) imports from ../../../api/hooks/useSignals (path parity of @/api/hooks/useSignals); SignalDescriptor (L17) imports from ../../../api/types (path parity of @/api/types, identical {name,category,value_kind,unit_kind,is_compound,is_setting_unit} shape).

CATEGORY_LABELS (L20-34) is ported byte-for-byte: charging/driving/climate/location/powertrain/vehicle_state/safety_security/media/config/prefs/setting_unit/metadata -> the same friendly labels. CATEGORY_ORDER (L36-50) is ported byte-for-byte in the same display order. categoryRank (L52-55): CATEGORY_ORDER.indexOf(id), -1 -> CATEGORY_ORDER.length so unknown categories sort last. friendlyCategoryLabel (L57-59): CATEGORY_LABELS[id] ?? id. All four are verbatim.

SignalCategoryTreeProps (L61-73) is ported with identical names/types: vehicleId (L62), selectedSignals (L63), onChange with the array|functional-updater union (L64), searchValue (L65), onSearchChange (L66), expandedGroupIds (L67), onExpandedChange (L68), showSparklines? (L69-70 with its disable-sparklines JSDoc), className? (L71), maxHeightClassName? (L72). className/maxHeightClassName are kept for source compatibility but ignored on native (RN has no Tailwind className); two native-only additions are appended: maxHeight?:number (numeric ~60vh scroll bound, replacing the max-h-[60vh] class) and style?:StyleProp<ViewStyle>.

SignalCategoryTree signature/destructure (L75-86) is ported (showSparklines defaults true L83; className/maxHeightClassName destructured as _className/_maxHeightClassName to mark them intentionally unused; +maxHeight, +style; +useWindowDimensions for the 60vh height). query = useAvailableSignals(vehicleId) (L87) is identical -> hits GET /signals/{vehicleID}/available via the shared hook.

The groups useMemo (L89-116) is ported verbatim: empty signals -> [] (L90-91), Map<string,SignalDescriptor[]> grouping by s.category (L92-97), per-category leaves sorted by a.name.localeCompare(b.name) (L100-102), each group pushed as {id:cat,label:friendlyCategoryLabel(cat),leaves:list.map(s=>({id:s.name,label:s.name,data:s}))} (L103-108), then out.sort by categoryRank then label.localeCompare (L109-114), deps [query.data] (L116). expandedSet = new Set(expandedGroupIds) (L119) and isSearching = searchValue.trim().length>0 (L120) are preserved for the renderLeafRight gate.

The TreeSelect JSX (L122-160) is rendered through the in-file native TreeSelectView<SignalDescriptor> with the same controlled props: groups (L124), selectedIds=selectedSignals (L125), onChange (L126), searchValue/onSearchChange (L127-128), expandedGroupIds/onExpandedChange (L129-130), isLoading=query.isLoading (L131), ariaLabel='Signal catalog' (L132), searchPlaceholder='Search signals…' (L133), emptyState computing the query.isError 'Failed to load catalog: ...' / 'No signals available for this vehicle.' branch verbatim (L134-138), className/maxHeightClassName (L139-140) -> the native maxHeight/style. The renderLeafRight slot (L141-159) keeps the showSparklines?...:undefined guard, computes groupId=leaf.data.category (L144) and enabled=isSearching||expandedSet.has(groupId) (L148), and renders SignalSparklinePreview with vehicleId/signal=leaf.id/valueKind=leaf.data.value_kind/enabled (L150-155). Closing tags (L160-162) mirrored.

SignalSparklinePreview is inlined as native parity of the ./SignalSparklinePreview sibling (not yet ported): SPARKLINE_LIMIT=30/SPARKLINE_HOURS=1, envelopesToNumbers (number push when finite, boolean->1/0), NON_NUMERIC Set('string','unknown','time'), the gated useSignalHistory(vehicleId,signal,{hours:1,limit:30}) query, the numericSeries useMemo, the !enabled->null short-circuit, the non-numeric chip (web <span> -> a bordered View + AppText with textTransform uppercase, title -> accessibilityLabel `Non-numeric signal (${valueKind})`), the query.isLoading pulse (web animate-pulse <span> -> a --surface-2 View flagged accessibilityElementsHidden), the <2-sample em-dash (title -> accessibilityLabel 'No samples in last hour'), and the numeric <Sparkline data color width height> using the shared native charts Sparkline. color defaults '#22d3ee', width 80, height 18 exactly as source.

TreeSelectView reproduces the exact @/components/forms TreeSelect subset SignalCategoryTree exercises: filterGroups (case-insensitive leaf-label substring; group-label match keeps all leaves; empty groups dropped), selectedSet, isExpanded=isSearching||expandedGroupIds.includes (search auto-expands every matching group so the sparkline enabled-gate fires), toggleExpanded (no-op while searching), totalLeafCount/visibleLeafIds/visibleSelectedCount, toggleLeaf/toggleGroup/toggleAllVisible (all via the functional-updater onChange so rapid taps merge), clearAll, the allVisibleSelected/someVisibleSelected tri-state, the isSearching selectAllLabel ('Select/Clear all' vs 'Select/Clear N visible'), and the showEmpty/showNoResults branches. UI: the shared <Input> search -> a bordered TextInput shell with a View-drawn magnifier (lucide Search) + a '×' clear Pressable (lucide X); the header select-all <Checkbox>+counts+'Clear all selected' <Button> row; the scroll body with the 4-bar loading skeleton, the empty/no-results placeholders, the group rows (chevron ▾/▸ for lucide ChevronDown/ChevronRight + tri-state group <Checkbox> + label + `{selected}/{total}` count) and the indented leaf rows (<Checkbox> + label + renderLeafRight slot).

Unavailable browser-only behavior is collapsed to native-safe equivalents and documented (rule 7): the web TreeSelect's WAI-ARIA role=tree/treeitem with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down/Home/End/Left/Right, useId, containerRef focus management) and its aria-live sr-only selection summary are DOM-only and have no portable touch affordance, so they collapse to accessibilityRole='button'/'checkbox' + accessibilityState {checked,indeterminate(approximated via fill),expanded,disabled}; group expand vs group-select is separated by nesting the checkbox Pressable inside the row Pressable (RN responder gives the inner control the touch). lucide-react icons and the cn/Tailwind theme vars map to StyleSheet literals (--surface-1/40 rgba(14,23,39,0.4), --surface-2 #151621, --glass-border colors.border, --text-* colors, the cyan accent). The source has no react-i18next usage, so every literal ('Signal catalog','Search signals…','Failed to load catalog: ...','No signals available for this vehicle.', the TreeSelect 'Select all'/'Clear all'/'Select N visible'/'N selected'/'Clear all selected'/'No matches for ...'/'Loading…') is preserved verbatim.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported (rule 4): only React + react-native primitives (Pressable, ScrollView, StyleSheet, TextInput, useWindowDimensions, View, type-only StyleProp/ViewStyle), the existing apps/native AppText primitive and theme colors token (rule 5), the shared native charts Sparkline, and the existing api/hooks/useSignals + api/types modules. Verified gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) passes, npm run lint -- --quiet passes (0 problems), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles passes.
